title: Malmgren read into legacy UAP retrieval program by Bissell
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Malmgren read into legacy UAP retrieval program by Bissell, about Cold War era at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In the diary, Richard Bissell who founded Area 51, mayor of Area 51. was key to Harold Malmgren's claims that he was read into the existence of the legacy UAP retrieval program by Richard Bissell.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says the diaries of a man named Harold Malmgren record that he was told about a long-running secret effort to recover crashed UAP, the government's term for unidentified flying objects. According to Coulthart, the person who let Malmgren in on it was Richard Bissell, a CIA figure who he says founded Area 51, a secret US test base. If true, it would mean such a recovery programme has existed for decades inside the government.
